events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Pete Alonso hit a two-run single, Tyler O’Neill had his third pinch-hit homer of the season, and the trade-depleted Baltimore Orioles beat the Los Angeles Angels 3-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pete Alonso hits 2-run single and trade-depleted Orioles beat Angels 3-1

headlines.description: — Elly De La Cruz and Sal Stewart drew walks leading off the eighth inning against Hogan Harris and both scored on wild pitches to help the Cincinnati Reds hand the Athletics a sixth straight loss, 5-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reds score twice in 8th on wild pitches to beat Athletics 5-4

events.name: New York Mets at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Luis Torrens had three hits — including a three-run homer in the second inning — and drove in four runs as the New York Mets defeated the Cleveland Guardians 6-2 on Tuesday night to snap a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luis Torrens hits 3-run homer and drives in 4 to lead Mets past Guardians 6-2

headlines.description: — Luis Arraez had two hits and two RBI in his Philadelphia debut, Jesús Luzardo allowed four hits in eight innings and the Phillies beat the Washington Nationals 5-0 on Tuesday night for their fourth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arraez has 2 hits and 2 RBIs in Phillies debut, Luzardo tosses 8 innings in 5-0 win over Nationals

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — George Lombard Jr. homered in a memorable big league debut and the New York Yankees beat the St. Louis Cardinals 2-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: George Lombard Jr. homers in memorable big league debut as Yankees blank Cardinals 2-0

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Caleb Durbin hit a grand slam, Patrick Sandoval earned his first major league win in more than two years and the Boston Red Sox extended their winning streak to six games with a 14-2 victory over the Chicago White Sox on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Durbin hits grand slam and Abreu goes deep twice as streaking Red Sox rout White Sox 14-2

headlines.description: — Ozzie Albies and Austin Riley hit home runs and the Atlanta Braves extended their winning streak to six games with a 4-2 victory over the Miami Marlins on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Albies and Riley homer, Braves beat Marlins 4-2 behind Grant Holmes’ 6 scoreless innings

events.name: Minnesota Twins at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Bobby Witt Jr. had three hits and two RBI in his return to the lineup Tuesday night, leading the Kansas City Royals to an 8-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bobby Witt Jr. returns from back injury and leads Royals to 8-2 win over Twins

headlines.description: — Jackson Chourio and Andrew Vaughn homered, Logan Henderson allowed two runs in six innings to win his sixth consecutive decision, and the Milwaukee Brewers beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 4-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chourio and Vaughn homer, Henderson wins sixth consecutive decision and Brewers top Pirates 4-2

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — The Chicago Cubs spoiled Tarik Skubal's debut with the slumping Los Angeles Dodgers on Tuesday night, posting a 5-1 victory behind key RBI singles by Nico Hoerner and Pete Crow-Armstrong.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nico Hoerner shines as the Cubs spoil Tarik Skubal's debut with Dodgers in 5-1 win

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Ezequiel Duran drove in four runs, the last on a game-ending double, and the Texas Rangers beat the San Francisco Giants 5-4 on Tuesday night to snap a season-worst six-game losing streak that knocked them out of the AL West lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ezequiel Duran has 4 RBIs as Rangers beat Giants 5-4 to end season-worst 6-game losing streak

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Taylor Trammell hit a three-run homer, Jose Altuve had three hits and two RBI, and the Houston Astros beat the Toronto Blue Jays 7-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trammell homers and Altuve has 2 RBIs in the Astros' 7-2 win over the Blue Jays

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Ben Williamson scored the tiebreaking run on a wild pitch in the 11th inning and Junior Caminero added a two-out RBI single as Tampa Bay rallied to beat Colorado 9-7 on Tuesday night after the Rockies roughed up
headlines.shortLinkText: Peralta roughed up in Rays debut but Hicks hits grand slam and Tampa Bay rallies past Rockies in 11

headlines.description: — Troy Melton threw seven sharp innings and Colt Keith hit a two-run single as the Detroit Tigers beat the Seattle Mariners 8-0 on Tuesday night to open their
headlines.shortLinkText: Troy Melton runs scoreless streak to 14 innings as Tigers beat Mariners 8-0 for 4th straight win

events.name: San Diego Padres at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Manny Machado had three hits and four RBI, Randy Vásquez threw six scoreless innings and the San Diego Padres jumped out to a big early lead in a 9-4 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manny Machado has four RBIs, Padres beat D-backs 9-4 to gain ground in NL wild card race
